titre: Your rook is attacked twice. Don't run! ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Grab a pawn or run away? Both only hold the balance. Trade rooks first, take on h6, and the black king is too far from the new passed pawn: it queens. Composed position, checked with Stockfish. Would you have grabbed the pawn? 👇
